name: arrival-card
title: Arrival Card
description: A square arrival widget: a drawn airliner cruises through a cloud deck that scrolls past behind the landing time.

perf.budget: Each cloud layer is drawn once and then slid as a view on the UI thread, so nothing redraws. The clouds and the sway animate at rest.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: three cloud layers slide and the plane sways. Holds about 30 fps on this old mid-range phone; Grain Drift measured the same there and Aurora Veil about 10 fps.

a11y.reducedMotion: The plane is in place from the start; it does not fly in or sway, and the clouds stand still.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("KN204. NRT, TOKYO. LANDS AT: 3:25PM. ON SCHEDULE").
